[](/YoungsoonLee/koreadatamcp/blob/main/go.mod) Pass Korean public APIs straight to an AI agent and it gets answers wrong. koreadatamcp gives it the right ones. An MCP server for Korean corporate filings and financials, stock prices, apartment sale prices, business registration status, public holidays, statutes and court rulings, from the official free APIs of OpenDART, data.go.kr and law.go.kr. Correct, with evidence. 47 traps found on the live APIs (wrong halfyear revenue, laws not in force yet, cancelled deals, district codes that changed in 2026, and more) are handled, each covered by a test that uses the real response. The full list is public: [What koreadatamcp handles for you](/YoungsoonLee/koreadatamcp/blob/main/docs/QUIRKS.md). In a [small evaluation](/YoungsoonLee/koreadatamcp/blob/main/eval/RESULTS.md), agents with koreadatamcp answered 10 of 10 questions with one call each; with the raw APIs they hit the traps, needed about 3x the calls, and missed one. Installs in one click. A single binary with nothing else to install. In Claude Desktop, open [koreadatamcp.mcpb](https://github.com/YoungsoonLee/koreadatamcp/releases/latest/download/koreadatamcp.mcpb) and enter your keys. Also in the [official MCP Registry](https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0.1/servers?search=io.github.YoungsoonLee/koreadatamcp). Private. It runs on your machine. Your keys and questions go only to the government APIs, never through a thirdparty server, and there is no telemetry. items.author: youngtip
items.descZh: koreadatamcp 是一款专为韩国公开数据设计的 MCP 服务器，旨在解决 AI 代理直接调用韩国官方 API 时因复杂数据陷阱（如错误半年报、未生效法律、已取消交易等共 47 种陷阱）而产生错误答案的痛点。它将 OpenDART、data.go.kr 和 law.go.kr 等官方免费 API 封装为 15 个工具，涵盖企业申报、股票、公寓交易、法规及判决，并提供带证据的准确数据。在实际评估中，集成该工具的 AI 代理能以每次仅 1 次调用、总计 10 次调用完美回答 10 个问题（准确率 100%），而直接使用原始 API 则需约 3 倍的调用量且会漏答一题。该工具支持一键单二进制部署及 Claude Desktop 接入，采用本地私有化运行，确保用户密钥仅直达政府 API，无第三方遥测。它非常适合需要高准确度、基于证据的韩国金融、房地产、法律及企业信息检索的 AI 智能体应用场景。
items.quote: 在一次小规模评估中，使用 koreadatamcp 的 agent 以每次调用一个 API 的方式，正确回答了全部 10 个问题；而使用原始 API 的 agent 则掉进了陷阱，调用次数大约是前者的 3 倍。

[Examples](/IrondomeDev/GATES/blob/main/examples/docs/README.md) · [Migration guide](/IrondomeDev/GATES/blob/main/docs/public/gates/migration.md) GATES GATES is a serverside library that blocks disposableemail signups and helps prevent multiple accounts created with email aliases, such as +tags and dotted Gmail addresses. It combines [IronDome](https://irondome.dev) disposableemail checks, Mail Canon normalization and PostgreSQLbacked ownership checks. Connectors are available for Better Auth, Auth0 and Supabase Auth. Email providers Alias rules are providerspecific. GATES does not strip dots or +tags from every email address. Provider Default alias matching Gmail / Googlemail Removes dots and +tags; maps googlemail.com to gmail.com. Outlook / Hotmail / Live / MSN Removes +tags on outlook.com, hotmail.com, live.com and msn.com. Keeps dots and each domain distinct. Proton Removes +tags, dots, underscores and hyphens. Keeps proton.me, protonmail.com, protonmail.ch and pm.me distinct. Fastmail Removes +tags on 130 supported firstparty domains and resolves onelevel subdomain aliases. Keeps dots and each root domain distinct. Custom domains Preserves the local part by default. Configure exactdomain rules for lowercasing, +tag removal or dot removal. Custom rules should only combine addresses you know reach the same mailbox. Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 custom domains do not inherit consumerprovider rules. GATES keeps the original address for delivery and verification; duplicate ownership is enforced within each project after verification. Installation npm install irondomegates pg See the [installation guide](/IrondomeDev/GATES/blob/main/docs/public/gates/installation.md) for requirements and setup. Requirements: Node.js 22+, ESM and PostgreSQL. The Better Auth connector requires Better Auth 1.7.7. Connectors [Better Auth](/IrondomeDev/GATES/blob/main/docs/public/gates/quickstart/betterauth.md) [Auth0](/IrondomeDev/GATES/blob/main/docs/public/gates/quickstart/auth0.md) [Supabase](/IrondomeDev/GATES/blob/main/docs/public/gates/quickstart/supabase.md) Each guide covers setup, verification, email changes, deletion and protected access. items.author: YPANDAR
items.descZh: GATES 是一款服务器端库，旨在阻止临时邮箱注册并防范利用邮箱别名（如 Gmail 的点号和加号标签）创建多个账户的行为。它整合了 IronDome 的 disposableemail 检测、Mail Canon 的邮件规范化以及基于 PostgreSQL 的所有权验证机制，同时提供 Better Auth、Auth0 和 Supabase 的连接器支持。针对不同邮件服务商，GATES 实施了精细化的别名规则，例如 Gmail 会移除点号和加号标签并映射 googlemail.com 到 gmail.com，Outlook 系列则仅移除加号标签而保留点号区分，Proton 和 Fastmail 也有各自的处理策略，同时允许自定义域名规则。该库在保留原始邮箱地址用于投递和验证的前提下，于验证通过后在项目内部强制执行重复所有权检查，从而有效识别同一真实用户。适用于需要严格控制用户注册质量、防止羊毛党和自动化脚本攻击的产品或服务。
items.quote: GATES 是一个服务端库，用于阻止一次性邮箱注册，并有助于防止使用邮箱别名（例如 +tags 和带点的 Gmail）创建多个账户。

items.author: Ubiquition
items.descZh: breatic 是一个面向创意团队的开源实时协作 AI 工作空间，旨在通过深度融合 AI 能力提升团队协同效率。其核心功能包括基于 Docker 和 docker-compose 的容器化部署方案、完善的 monorepo 架构（支持 pnpm workspace）以及自托管（self-host）能力，方便团队进行私有化部署。项目代码库展示了高达 11,166 次提交，并集成了精细的 Claude 技能配置、多环境变量管理及严格的 ESLint 规则，确保了极高的工程化水平与代码可维护性。该工具特别适用于需要数据本地化、高度定制工作流的中小型创意及设计团队，用于实时文档协作、AI 辅助创作与项目管理。

items.author: silas0521
items.descZh: DockShift是一款基于浏览器的即时工具，旨在简化Docker容器的部署与管理，无需服务器端处理。其核心功能包括将Docker Run命令转换为Docker Compose YAML文件，支持反向转换，并能导出结构化的JSON AST格式，便于AI代理集成。亮点在于提供100%客户端隐私保护，确保所有操作在本地浏览器完成，无数据上传风险，同时实现零服务器往返的实时解析，提升转换速度与安全性。该工具适用于开发者快速部署标准容器栈（如Nginx、PostgreSQL等），并支持一键加载示例，特别适合DevOps团队和AI自动化场景。
items.quote: 即时浏览器内 Docker Run 到 Docker Compose 的转换器，可将 Compose 反向转换为 Run CLI，并为 AI 代理导出结构化的 JSON AST。
